data_fields.name: trigger_radius_tiles
data_fields.donor_constant: distance field (5-bit record field), square of 2*distance+1 tiles

data_fields.name: night_window
data_fields.donor_constant: nocturnal: blocked for hour 5 to 20, active for 21 to 4

data_fields.name: once
data_fields.donor_constant: once flag: removed after a successful hatch

data_fields.name: rearm_auto_reset
data_fields.donor_constant: auto_reset flag: hatched gate ignored, re-rolls on each entry

best_idea: A spawn point is zone data: an edge-triggered tile square, one percentage roll per entry, a group size, a once or re-arm flag, a night window, and a placement search from the spawn tile outward.
decision_why: The spawn point as zone data (square, chance, group, once or re-arm, night window) fits a server zone director; the donor is GPL so we keep only the shape, and the trigger must be evaluated by the server from the authoritative tile, not the client.
acceptance: A server test walks a seeded player into a spawn square and asserts one edge trigger per entry, no trigger in the night-blocked hours for a night-only point, and at most group_max foes placed at free tiles within place_radius; in play the group appears around the spawn tile, not on the player.
